reason: Exadel is a 25+ year-old, 2,000+ person global software outsourcing consultancy staffing engineers onto Fortune 500 client projects — its FinOps/SRE/DevOps postings are client-delivery requisitions ('About the Client' sections), not confessions of its own pain, and it is both a services shop selling adjacent expertise and far too large for a fractional CTO targeting Series A-C product companies.
